I am an old woman here in Balaka, and this small piece of land is all I have for maize to feed my family. The rains here are not like they used to be — last years have been dry and the harvest was small, so I must be careful with the little money I have. My neighbors who got the coupon put the fertilizer, but me I did not get the coupon this year, so I will only put the manure from my goats and chickens that I have been keeping. I will plant the seed I kept from last harvest because buying new seed from the shop is too much money for my small garden, and I will work the plot myself with my daughter when she comes to help.
